records.Message: Hurry it up! I’ve got places to be!
What are you stopping me for? Whatever, just hurry up and ask your questions!
This is so annoying… Fine, let’s get this over with.
Huh!? Did I screw up somehow?
H-Hello…Is s-something the matter…?
Er…Can I help you?
What seems to be the problem, Officer?
Is something wrong? Is there any way I can help?
No problem, what do you need from me?
Hi. What do you need me to do?
Sure. What do I need to do?
For sure, no problem.
Man, this sucks! I don’t have time for your nonsense!
I’m busy! Go find someone else!
No chance! Try catching me first!
…I didn’t do anything wrong.
Don’t… don’t come after me!
Don’t come any closer!
Sorry, but can we do this some other time? I’ve got things to do.
Sure, I’ve gotta handle a few things, but I’ll be right back. You sit tight.
Oh, uh…I just remembered I’ve got somewhere to be! Gotta go!
I’m straight-up cursed today!
Damn you! You brought this on yourself!
Beat me in a fight first, then we’ll talk testing.
Bummer, looks like things are gonna have to get physical.
There’s no going back now. Let’s rumble!
I’m terribly sorry, Officer!
Alright, go ahead and test.
What a hassle! Ugh, fine.
Are we done yet? Can we wrap this up?
O-Okay…
Er…okay…go ahead…
Well, I suppose that’s fine. I don’t have anything else going on…
How long is this going to take, Officer?
Again? Was there something wrong with the first one?
What? You want to do it again?
Get someone else to play your games! I don’t want to keep going back and forth with you.
Are you out of your mind? I should knock you out and put an end to this!
Quit playing with me! You’re just looking to stir up trouble.
This is too much! I’m not doing this!
Why are you making me do all this?
If you intend on treating me harshly, I’ll respond in kind!
I’m so sorry, but I need to get going. Something urgent just came up…
Um…can we call it here? I’m in a bit of a hurry…
I-I’m sorry, but I need to go!
I don’t want to be rude, but I have to go!
Sorry, but I’m really in a hurry.
I hate to cut this off, but I really have things to do. I’ll contact you later.
Fine, you win. Do what you gotta do.
It’s important to concede when you’ve lost. Do what you will.
Ask away. I’m an open book.
Stop, stop, stop! I’ll do whatever you want! Just say the word…
Ask away! I’m an open book! I’ll tell you everything there is to know.
I’m begging you, please take it easy on me! I’ll do whatever you want!
Don’t hurt me, I beg of you! I’ll tell you everything, honest!
I’ll cooperate, I’ll cooperate! Please, have a heart!
Don’t hurt me, please! I’ll do as you say!
Please let me go! I’m throwing in the towel! I’ll tell you everything!
What is it you wanna know? Ask…and I’ll answer.
You actually caught me!? Fine, I’ll comply, you hear!?
Why should I answer you?
You sure are nosy. What I did is none of your business!
You think you can fine me for no good reason? Not happening!
Me? I’m <policeExamineNpcName>, a <policeExamineNpcJob>.
Officer, my name’s <policeExamineNpcName>, and I’ve always been a law-abiding citizen. You must have the wrong person.
My name is <policeExamineNpcName>, a <policeExamineNpcJob>. May…may I leave now?
I don’t want to answer that question.
I have the right not to answer.
Do I really have to answer?
I’m a <policeExamineNpcJob>.
I’m an upstanding Nova citizen. My name is <policeExamineNpcName>.
I’m <policeExamineNpcPortrait>, <policeExamineNpcName>.
Get to the point! Can we speed this along?
I wasn’t doing anything!
What? You’re prying into my personal life!
I… I’m heading home…
I… I was just going out for a walk.
I’m sorry, I did run a red light today! I’m really sorry! Oh jeez…
I’m out on a walk, Officer.
Just a casual stroll, that’s all.
I’m on my way to get something to eat.
I haven’t really decided what I should get up to today…
Going home, of course.
I have things to take care of. It’s urgent. Is there any way we can speed this up, Officer?
No way! That machine of yours must be faulty!
How could I not know who I am! Are you messing with me?
What is wrong with you people? First you screw up my ID, then you blame me for it!
I… I didn’t… it must be a mistake…
I lent my ID to someone before. Maybe that’s what caused the mix-up…
I really didn’t mean to, can you let me go…?
Huh? How is this info wrong? It’s not a big deal, right?
There’s so much going on, mistakes are inevitable. I’ll fix it in a few days.
There must be a problem with my information. I’ll get right on fixing that.
Who are you to lecture me? I’m just too lazy and haven’t updated my info.
It’s just an expired ID. What’s the big deal? If anyone’s to blame, it’s you for not notifying me.
You guys didn’t remind me in advance! You all are lying in wait, wanting to jump at the opportunity to make my life difficult!
Huh? Expired… will I really get punished for this? Aw man…
I’m sorry! I honestly forgot…
I’m so sorry! I know I’m in the wrong! I’ll be more careful next time!
Okay, I’ll update it in a couple of days.
Thank you for reminding me. I’ll take care of that later.
Thanks for the reminder, Officer. I’m planning to update my ID soon.
It’s self-defense, is there a problem with that?
You better not take it! I paid good money for this!
If you want to try to take it, go right ahead. See if I care!
I… I truly wasn’t aware!
Sorry… I won’t make this mistake again.
I’m really sorry…I didn’t meant to do anything illegal.
It’s for self-defense. It’s totally normal. Please understand.
Hey, I never intended to use this for nefarious purposes. Can’t you look the other way, just this once?
I bought it for a collection. Can’t you show me a little leniency?
You say it’s prohibited, and I’m simply supposed to take your word for it? I think you just want to take my stuff!
I didn’t do anything wrong! Why are you making trouble for me!
And what if it is prohibited? What are you going to do about it!?
I-I swear, I don’t know nothin’…
Huh? Is this really mine… must’ve mixed it up…
I…I really didn’t know this was illegal.
Man, I shoulda known better…
I knew I couldn’t keep this hidden!
I have the right to remain silent.
I’m not drunk! Your machine must be messed up!
Drunk? No way! I can hold my liquor like nobody’s business! No chance I’m drunk!
This must be a mistake! Your equipment’s rigged!
My bad… I’m sorry…
I swear, it won’t happen again… can you give me a pass just this once?
I… I only had a lil’ sip…
I was vibin’ and ended up going a bit hard on the sauce. I messed up, I’ll admit that.
Look, it’s not like this is some apocalyptic crime scene, right? Can’t we sweep this under the rug?
Yeah, I deserve to get dinged for this. I promise not to do it again.
This is a loan! I didn’t steal it!
Stealing? I’m better than that! I earned this!
This is money that was rightfully owed to me! You all owe me!
Weird… I have no idea how this ended up on me.
My bad… I couldn’t help myself and took someone else’s stuff.
I-I’m terrible at lying… I mean, at explaining myself.
Well, I know I messed up, so I’ll take the fine.
Me and my homie were just playin’ around. I was gonna give it back. Don’t get it twisted.
Chill! I was just messin’ with that dude. I didn’t mean to steal nothin’.
What’s it to you? Is it a crime to have fun?
What? You want it too? Planning to pocket it for yourself?
I ain’t hurtin’ nobody! Don’t start with me!
I… I didn’t eat it… there must be a mistake…
No… that’s not it, I… I was forced into it…
Everyone was pressuring me, and I-I couldn’t take it… so I bought it.
I’ve had a condition ever since I was a kid. I can’t think straight without this.
I suffer from an incurable disease. This is the medicine I take to cope.
I’m so miserable; being doped up is the only form of relief I have.
Hey! You won’t even let me take my meds?
Sick people take medicine! What’s the problem?
Why’ve you gotta stick your nose into everyone’s business?
So… can I go home?
I’ll be careful next time, I promise.
I didn’t know this stuff was a controlled substance… honest!
A doctor prescribed this to me, deadass.
I can’t catch a break; just tell me how much the fine is.
It’s just a little side hustle. I ain’t hurt nobody! Come on, cut me some slack!
It’s just a….tiny sip. Chill out, it’s no big deal.
My driving skills are… the shiznit! A little booze won’t… do nuthin’!
Huh? I swear… I haven’t touched a drop… Do I look like I’m drunk?
I… I might’ve accidentally guzzled the wrong thing…
My bad… I had no clue that drink had booze in it…
Come on, cut me some slack… I busted my butt to get my license…
Sorry, I accidentally drank a bit of alcohol.
Ugh, guess it was wishful thinking…
I was in the wrong for driving under the influence. Do what you gotta do.
Where do you get off acting all high and mighty, telling me what to do!?
You little punk! Who do you think you are?
I know people in the PM’s Office! What makes you so special?
Ah… I swear, I just munched on some chips…
They handed them to me… Oh man… I’m so screwed!
I can’t believe I pulled this crap… I deserve whatever comes to me.
Hey! Don’t throw around crazy accusations!
I’m sorry, I honestly didn’t realize what was going on…
I messed up! My bad! I shouldn’t have done that.
I just took back what’s mine! Is that a crime?
You guys are the biggest crooks in Nova City!
This is mine! What’s it got to do with you?
I… I swiped it by accident, honest.
Nah… I didn’t. I picked that stuff up off the street, that’s all!
Is…Is there any chance you could let me off the hook? I don’t want this to ruin my life…
Aw man… I can’t believe I got caught. What a drag!
Alright, fine! I stole something, okay?
This is a loan! I was about to return it, so it doesn’t count as stealing.
I should’ve just run you over!
Damn it, why’d I have to run into you?
That dude had it coming!
Look, I had an emergency at the time, so I took off.
I was scared and didn’t know what to do, so I bolted.
I’m sorry… what can I do to fix this?
Looks like I really got caught….
You can only run for so long…
I’ll take responsibility for my mistakes…
It’s that guy’s fault! He asked for it!
I didn’t do anything wrong! He started the whole thing!
Go ahead! Punish me! I haven’t done anything wrong!
It was an accident, honestly.
I was forced into it…
I… I didn’t have a choice…
Yeah yeah, I did it. Throw the book at me.
That guy was the instigator.
I just acted on instinct, alright?
Figured I get nabbed by the cops. Worst luck ever!
Go ahead, toss me in the clink. What’s it to me? My boss will get me out!
I’m warning you, if you mess with me, you’re gonna get burned!
Ah… wait… you’ve got the wrong person…
Please! Let me go! I don’t want to go back there!
Can I at least go see my family first?
Listen to me. Turn around and walk away, for both our sakes.
I don’t wanna go back at that hellhole! It’s deathly boring!
Listen, you’re running the rat race right alongside the rest of us. Everyone slips up; no need to resort to conflict.
This stinks! Just my luck to run into trouble again!
You won’t like what happens if you get in the way of my hustle.
Know your place! Arresting me won’t do you any favors. Let me go and you might still make out well from this.
This…this isn’t right…I’m innocent…
Officer, you’ve got the wrong person…
No… no… there’s been a mistake…
Just give me a fine and we’ll call it even, okay?
This isn’t even your case, why are you butting in for?
You trying to shake me down too? Man, you’re like a bunch of flies I can’t swat!
I earned that cash fair and square! What’s your problem?
What’s the problem? That’s all my hard-earned dough!
You better not make baseless accusations against me, or I’ll report you!
No… that’s not how it went down…
I was just looking to pick up a side gig. You’ve got it all wrong…
I got pressured into this…
It’s because they were greedy. If they weren’t, they wouldn’t have fallen for it.
Just my rotten luck.
I’ve had a good run, and you wanna take me in? I’d like to see you try.
Hey! You cruising for a bruising or what?
I suggest you think twice before you open your mouth!
Don’t be so ungrateful!
This isn’t even your case, don’t stir up trouble!
Then go ahead and arrest me! It’s just a little time in the can.
I just took what I was owed. If you’ve got a problem with that, go ahead and arrest me!
You bloodsuckers! Can’t stand to see anyone else get rich, can you?
They willingly lent me the money! What’s the issue?
You guys take my money, and now you want to talk about robbery!
I… I was just helping someone raise some funds…
Aw man… I had no idea this was illegal before I got into it, promise…
But… they told me it was a charity project…
If you say so.
I steadfastly refute all charges against me. I’ll see you in court, and I’ll be bringing my lawyer.
What did I do wrong? Once I start making money, I’ll share the profits with them!
You’re not really gonna slap the cuffs on me for this, are ya?
Hey, officer! You’ve already taken my money, and you still want to arrest me?
If you’re telling me my hobby isn’t allowed, then there’s nothing more to discuss!
They said… it was just for fun, you know?
A little gambling shouldn’t land me in jail, right?
This is so unfair… I was only serving tea, I didn’t even participate…
We were just playing a game. Totally on the up and up.
Okay, I admit it, I skipped on my taxes.
It’s a bummer this is how a legendary gambler like me got pinched.
Are you telling me I can’t sell my own stuff?
What relics? These hunks of junk wish they were relics!
I’m so fed up with this! Why are you putting all these charges on me?
Those were all passed down to me from my ancestors…
I get it, I messed up…
Please don’t make this harder for me, alright? I’m doing it for my family…
Relics? I had no clue those were relics.
Are you really gonna take me in for this?
I don’t see any problem with selling my family’s old stuff.
Sure, you can scan my face I guess.
Okay, I’m cooperating.
I understand. Do whatever you need to do.
Okay, go ahead.
Would you hurry it up? I’ve got places to be!
Uh…has something bad happened?
Er…O-Okay…I’m co-cooperating…
<policeExamineNpcName>，我的名字，品种则是<policeExamineNpcJob>。
我叫<policeExamineNpcName>，正在刷里程数，目前的发动机状态还不错。
我的书名是<policeExamineNpcName>，其他信息你可以自己翻阅一下。
You intend to search me? Surely you jest!
Got nothing better to do than harass me, do you? Fine, bring it on!
You wanna frisk me? Try it, and I’ll clock you!
I’m not gonna let you frame me!
Uh…it doesn’t seem to be working…
Oh my goodness! Something’s going on over there!
I… I don’t wanna get locked up…
Gaaaah, let me go, please…
Huh? Is something wrong?
Um…that should be good enough, right?
Again? That’s a bit weird…
There’s more?
What’s the deal? You back for seconds?
Sorry, I must have messed up somewhere. Let me try again…
Did I do it wrong? I can do it again if you want…
I’ve had it about up to here with you all! Nothing but bullies with badges!
Good grief, how long is this going to take!?
You’re just looking for trouble, aren’t you?
Looks like you need to be set straight!
Is there something wrong with my ID? Why do you keep checking it?
What in the world are you after? If you’ll excuse me!
What? Why do you have to search me? Fine…
I don’t trust you…I’m leaving…
Fine, search away.
Okay, be my guest.
Fine, but make it quick. I’m in a hurry.
Fine! You ain’t gonna find nothin’ no how!
Go right ahead! When you don’t find anything, I’ll report you for abuse of power!
Is-Is this really necessary? Er…Fine.
Uh, o-okay. Could we make it quick, though?
可以。不过我可不会往身体里塞奇怪的填充物，现在的形状很完美。
呀！是要帮我梳理毛发吗？我不讨厌这种事……记得顺着纹理捋哦。
行吧，我的身体也没什么特别的，只是标准的产品，没有装高级配件。
You wanna frisk me? I’ve got two words for you: hell no!
No, stay away from me!
You dare search me? You need to learn your place!
You wanna search me? Back off!
Sorry, but I’m running late. Some other time!
Oh boy, now’s not the best time. Maybe later?
C-Could you not stand so close to me…?
I don’t have anything on me, I swear…
This is all I’ve got on me, Officer.
What exactly are you hoping to find?
You’ve gone over me with a fine-tooth comb.
There’s more?
What’s the deal? You back for seconds?
Fine…I’ll do as you say…
Has something happened…?
You think you’re a big bad cop, but you’ll find I’m not so easy to push around.
What is going on here? This is highly unnecessary.
You try to touch me, and we’re gonna have a problem!
Looks like you need to be set straight!
Sorry, but I dropped something back there! I’ve gotta go get it!
I’m so over this. I’m leaving.
I don’t mean to be rude, but there’s something off about you…
Is all this really necessary…?
Very well, I’ll undergo your test.
Sure, I’ll cooperate.
You can start whenever you’re ready.
Why am I the only one getting tested?
Why aren’t you testing the others too?
U-Uh…okay…oh man, I’m kinda nervous…
O-Okay…I’m not really sure how this works though…
好吧，酒精这种燃料的确存在不少问题，不过应该对我的发动机影响很小。
放心，我的身体结构已经把它们过滤掉了，不会滞留在纤维里。
没问题，我很讨厌这种溶剂，会让身体脱胶。
Don’t touch me!
Absolutely not! I’ve done nothing wrong!
You’re framing me? You wanna catch these hands?
So what if I had a drink? What’s it to you?
Man, I’m parched! Let me get some water.
Oh boy…can’t breathe…gotta calm down…
Don’t grab me…
I’m begging you, I can’t get tested!
Is this going to take all day or what!?
Did I not blow into it right?
So long as your equipment isn’t faulty, a second test shouldn’t be necessary.
There’s more?
What’s the deal? You back for seconds?
There’s more? Fine, let’s do this…
Okay, but are you sure there’s nothing wrong with your equipment…?
Have you got it out for me or something?
This is no way to treat another human being!
You’re just looking for trouble, aren’t you?
Looks like you need to be set straight!
Stop testing me, I’m fine!
Enough! I’m in a rush here!
What… what do you want from me?
There’s something off about you. I’m not doing any more tests…
Whoa, that’s a new doodad to me. How does it work?
Very well, you have my full cooperation.
Sure, go right ahead.
Alright. I didn’t do anything wrong, so I’m not scared.
Am I under suspicion? Fine, I’ll clear my name myself!
Uh…what exactly do you need me to do?
Are you sure this thing’s safe…?
可以，我有时确实会食用一些菌类，但我有信心靠嗅觉辨别出不能食用的致幻蘑菇。
放心吧，作为一个合格的样本，我不会吃观察员放置在食槽外的东西。
谢谢你的关心，但我的皮肤光滑致密，没有任何霉斑和腐烂，清脆可口，毫无问题。
I haven’t done anything, so I don’t need to do no tests!
This is a violation of my rights as an individual!
You must be outta your mind!
I ain’t taken nothin’! Why you testin’ me?
You’re infringing on my personal privacy!
I’m not taking any of your tests, so leave me alone.
This device doesn’t seem particularly safe…
N-No!
Can you just let me go?
Can I leave once the test is all sorted?
Is there something wrong with the results?
Are you still not done? I’m about to go cross-eyed!
Are we done here yet?
Sorry, but how much longer is this going to be?
Okay, but my eyes aren’t in the best shape…
I’ve got half a mind to accuse you of abuse of power.
Why are you always giving me a hard time?
This isn’t cool!
I’m not the one losing it—it’s you!
Excuse me, but I must get going. Things to do, places to be.
You have my information, so I’ll be on my way.
You’re up to something when I’m not looking, aren’t you?
Something feels off here…
I’m not resisting…even though I’m not entirely sure what’s going on.
I don’t understand it myself, but you must have your reasons…
The heck are you doing?
That’s a strange ask! Fine, whatever.
What? Am I in danger?
Hmm…Okay…
哦，感谢提醒，我确实要看看盖子有没有密封好，否则里面的东西容易洒出来。
原来如此，我记得，把手臂架起来，确实能形成闭合回路，准确接收您的指令。
既然是您的要求，那我现在就休眠吧。合拢花瓣，包裹花蕊。
This doesn’t make a lick of sense!
What’s the big idea?
Why should I?
Cut the BS!
Okay…like this?
Can we wrap this up? I have things to do.
Yeah… Sure…
Huh? Did I do something wrong?
Are you trying to make my life difficult on purpose?
This is far too unreasonable, and you do not have my consent.
You want me to put my hands on my head? Hell no!
Are you messing with me? You’re asking for trouble!
Okay, whatever you say.
Crouch down? Okay.
What a ridiculous request!
You’d better wrap this up soon!
I… I’ll do what you say.
I… I’ll squat down.
明白，您需要我把自己折叠起来。这样确实能省出空间，方便您把我塞进后备箱。
咦？我其实还没准备好在这里坐窝。需要我孵多久呢？
压缩自己？这会有点危险，蓄能过大的话，我可能弹射到天上。
What a bizarre request!
Quit screwing with me!
This is some kind of power trip for you, isn’t it?
I don’t want to!
How much longer until we’re done here?
I’m a bit confused, but I’ll do what you say.
What else do you want me to do?
How much longer do I have to squat?
Why are you harassing me?
I’ve about had it up to there with this.
Is this how you treat people? You need to be taught a lesson!
What? Do you have a screw loose?
Are you serious? Okay, fine.
I’m not so sure I follow, but I’ll do what you say.
Okay, okay, hurry it up!
What’s the deal here? Can we cut to the chase already?
Huh? What is this?
That’s a weird request, but alright…
我会把自己铺开，可以放心把脚踩在我背上，会让您很舒服。
体贴如您，把柔软的腹部贴在地板上进行热交换，确实能让我放松。
好吧，我会成为合格的原木，你想把我加工成什么？
What are you trying to pull?
What for?
You’re the one who should be getting down!
Get down? You’re the one who’s going down!
Fine, we can keep going.
Are we done here?
I honestly don’t understand why we have to do this…
Huh? Are we in some kind of danger?
Are you getting a kick out of pestering me?
Jeez, you’re like a cat playing with a mouse!
What is this nonsense? Down again?
It’s your turn to get down!
Is that everything, Officer?
So, can I leave?
Enough already! I’ve had it up to here with all this!
Be smart about this. I’m done playing your games.
So…are we done?
Surely this should be enough?
Alright, that’s my bad. I can cop to that.
I understand. I’ll keep that in mind down the line.
Very well. I’ll pay whatever the fine is.
Fine. Guess I was just unlucky this time.
Damn it! Consider this money a personal gift.
Dang it… I’ll make sure to pay on time.
I made a mistake… I’m sorry… I’ll pay as soon as I can.
这些彩色的纸片质地坚韧，难怪你也想拿去用唾液粘合筑巢。
又到了剪毛的季节？我最近又产了很多，你刮走吧。但刮完要下个月才能长出来了。
哦，储藏太多这些东西，确实会发生阻塞，的确需要疏通。
Wha…haven’t you punished me enough?
After all that, you’re still sticking me with a fine!?
Ugh, whatever. I’ll pay it.
That’s enough. I don’t want to see you again!
Haven’t you made enough money? Let me go!
This fine feels a bit excessive… No, I’m okay with it…
So… is my punishment over?
Do you enjoy pushing other people around?
You’re way out of line!
This fine is outrageous! You might as well take it as medical fees!
I don’t have the money to pay this! You might as well let me go to jail.
You’re fining me!? Are you serious? Let me look at my bank account…
Quit trying to squeeze me for a few quick bucks!
Please, have mercy, will you? Go and fine someone else…
Something’s fishy about this…
You don’t scare me!
Abuse of power! Police brutality!
You’re getting off on this, aren’t you? How’d you like it if I fine you!?
I won’t back down. I haven’t done anything illegal!
Hey! I want to file a report! There’s an officer issuing fines randomly!
You call yourself an NCCA officer? You’re nothing but a crook with a badge!
NCCA? I want to confirm something about an officer…
Is this the NCCA? I’ve got a problem…
This fine is criminal! There’s no way I’m paying this.
I’ll work with you, but I didn’t break any laws.
Fine, let’s go. I’ll prove to them that I’m innocent.
Fine, I’ll plead my case at the NCCA.
You’re just bullying honest, hardworking people! You’ll regret this!
Just wait until I get out! You’ll see!
Wh-Why is this happening? I don’t understand…
I’ll follow your orders; please don’t hurt me…
我……不是劣质品，请不要拿我去拆解检查。
别抓我！我的尖牙已经被拔掉了，也接受过绝育手术了，我是无害的。
我讨厌项圈和链条，别想驯服我！
…I did the crime, so I should do the time.
You don’t understand, I had no choice! Please, let me walk.
Fine, I’ll go, but I want a lawyer.
Ha, so it’s a jail cell, big whoop. Who’s afraid of that?
Tch! You only caught me this time by pure luck!
No… please don’t! I don’t want to go to jail!
I deserve this… I brought it on myself.
You’re a disgrace to the uniform! You disgust me!
What is this!? You trying to frame me!?
I’m gonna make you regret slandering me!
Corrupt cop! I’m gonna take you down!
I’m not going to prison, and if I have to go through you, then so be it!
You think you can push me around? I’ll show you what time it is!
I’ll do whatever I want! You don’t get to tell me what to do!
You think you can catch me? In your dreams!
要争夺这里的领地是吗？我不会输的！
为了赢得交配权，我必须在这场战斗中胜出！
我已经受够了被当作猎物玩弄！你这烦人的猫要付出代价！
You just messed around, and you’re about to find out!
I didn’t do anything wrong! Leave me be!
Just my luck…I didn’t do anything…
Why are you doing this…?
No no no! I won’t survive a day in prison!
If you’ll excuse me, I have urgent matters to attend to.
S-Stay away…you’re scaring me!
No…this can’t be…
Thank you for your service, Officer.
I have places to go and people to see, Officer, so I have to go.
Tch! At least you’re being reasonable!
Fine! I won’t hold a grudge against you.
I’m just glad it’s finally over…
Thanks for everything you do!
放……放生我？真的吗？
拒……拒收吗？请，请给我一个明确的退货理由。
我合格了？好耶，可以正常出库了。
Huh? Officer, where are you going?
Oh? If you’ve got something to do, go ahead.
What? You search me, then leave in the middle of it?
What’s going on here? Are you pulling my leg?
Uh… Officer, am I supposed to keep waiting here?
So… is the questioning over?
Wait… Officer, are you going to just leave me here?
What? Officer, where are you off to? Don’t forget to come back for me.
Hey! What are you doing, leaving me here!?
What the…are you coming or going!?
What in the world are you doing, Officer?
Don’t just leave me on the side of the road!
明白了，主人！要早点回来帮我解开绳子。
好的，我现在会亮起红灯，也不会移动。
为什么要把目光移开呢？难道我的节目不精彩吗？
What happened…?
Huh? What’s going on…?
You’ve got my head spinning…
What’s wrong…?
Stop! Stop! I surrender!
Stop! I messed up, I admit it!
Please take it easy on me, Officer. I promise I won’t do it again.
It’s all my fault! I screwed up…do what you have to do.
这场战争是我输了，随意处置我吧。
好吧，我承认以后你是这片领地的老大，就不必把我关进笼子了吧。
等等！不要把我送去回收站！我还有用！我不是垃圾！
Oh jeez, what rotten luck!
Dang it, if only I could run a bit faster.
Unhand me! You’re not taking me in!
Argh, you’re like a bad stench I can’t get rid of!
Hey, ease up! I’m not going anywhere!
I really screwed the pooch this time…I won’t run off!
Alright, I’m coming out.
Okay, Officer.
You want to search me? Go right ahead.
What is it you need from me, Officer?
Wh-Why is this happening? I’m a perfectly upstanding citizen.
Are you sure you’re not making a mistake, Officer?
What’s going on? I didn’t do anything wrong…
Okay…I-I’ll do as you say.
查吧，反正我是合格品。
好吧，从壳里出来这件事很危险，请保护好我。
行，我是良种，不是杂草，能结果实，没长虫斑。
Fine, I’ll do it.
I’m happy to comply, Officer.
Fine by me. Go right ahead.
Sure. This shouldn’t take too long, right?
Can we put a pin in this? I’m really in a rush!
Is this ever going to end? Can I go or not?
Do you plan on keeping me here all day? Hurry it up, will you?
What a pain. Fine, search away.
Okay…can we try and do this quickly?
Well… Fine, go ahead.
Has something happened, Officer? Is it really necessary to be this thorough?
Huh? Is there something wrong?
Sorry, but now’s not a great time.
Apologies, but I haven’t got time to spare.
Move aside! I have more important things to do.
I’ll have to take a rain check.
You wanna search me? Never gonna happen!
You’re gonna have to catch me first!
There’s nothing to see here. Move aside!
Eat my dust!
Please don’t frisk me…
Leave me alone! I-I haven’t done anything…
You…You’ve got the wrong person…
I…I’d rather you not search me…
抱歉！我不太稳定，随时有可能发生爆炸！
不好意思，我暂时被其他人借用了。
records.__RAW__Message: 不好意思，我暂时被其他人借用了。

records.Message: 嘿！离我远点！退到作业安全距离外！铅封松动，小心辐射！
records.__RAW__Message: 嘿！离我远点！退到作业安全距离外！铅封松动，小心辐射！

records.Message: How is this still going on…?
Time to peel off and flee the scene.
Damn, I couldn’t shake you!
You’re really starting to piss me off.
You’ll never catch me!
It ain’t over till it’s over! Keep chasing me!
You don’t stand a chance! We’ll see who’s the fastest!
You’re nothing but a thug!
Wha…you’re still after me?
You really don’t budge an inch, do you?
Aw man…I can’t let myself be caught!
You went through all that just to arrest me?
Aw man…why are you pressing me like this?
This isn’t how I wanted it to go either, Officer.
Screw it. This is like talking to a brick wall.
Can’t you look the other way, just this once?
Don’t you ever give up!? You’re like a rabid dog!
This is your fault! You pushed me into a corner!
Time to let my fists do the talking!
I don’t care who you are; whoever messes with me gets the smoke!
一定要执行灭绝计划吗？我，没有生存空间了。
records.__RAW__Message: 一定要执行灭绝计划吗？我，没有生存空间了。

records.Message: 捕食者！我可不会乖乖就范！我会让你付出代价。
records.__RAW__Message: 捕食者！我可不会乖乖就范！我会让你付出代价。

records.Message: 不行，我不会让你把我抓去泡在福尔马林里。
records.__RAW__Message: 不行，我不会让你把我抓去泡在福尔马林里。

records.Message: Okay, okay, I give! You can stop chasing me!
Argh…fine, just take me in.
I surrender. Take me away.
Damn, shows me for being so full of myself.
I can’t take much more of this…
I know I drove off, but I wasn’t in my right mind!
I’m sorry, I know I shouldn’t have run…
I’m sorry for any trouble I caused…
I should’ve known I couldn’t shake you.
Alright, do your worst.
Can’t believe you actually got me.
Dang it, I nearly gave you the slip.
Fine, come and arrest me then!
I don’t care what you do. I’m not getting out of the car.
I’m staying right here.
Do what you have to do.
I’m not doing anything! What are you gonna do about it?
And if I stay in the car? What then?
Come and strong arm me, if you’ve got the guts!
You better watch it, or I’ll report you for breaking the law yourself!
I…I’d really rather not…
Do I have to? I don’t want to get out…
I’m scared of what you’ll do to me…
I’m staying right here inside the car.
It’s my fault, I can admit that. I’ll get out.
Hey, chill out! I was planning on getting out anyway.
Ow, that hurts! Don’t hurt me! I’ll get out of the car!
I was confused earlier! There’s no need for violence! I’m getting out of the car!
I’m sorry, Officer, go easy on me…I’m getting out of the car now…
I-I’m complying! I’m getting out of the car now…
Don’t be mad, Officer…I won’t make a run for it…
Don’t bother, I can get out myself…
Who the hell are you!?
You’re questioning me? You’ve gotta be kidding!
I’ll give you a reason to question me! You wanna throw down?
Hey… hey…
I’ve got a stomach cramp…
Can you let me slip away for a sec to handle this?
Ahhhhhh!
That hurts! That smarts!
I need an ambulance…
Ouch… ouch…
I’m about to pass out…
Come on, just let me off this once…
Officer! What’s that over there?
Look! There’s some sketchy dudes over there!
Whoa! Looks like there’s a Chaos causing trouble over there!
Hey Officer, if I “sweeten” the deal, how about we forget this ever happened?
I’m afraid that’s not possible. Please cooperate with the search.
Fine! I’m trying to be polite, and you’re brushing me off!
Officer, how about I give you a little somethin’ somethin’, and you let this slide?
Bribing an officer is also a crime.
I’m trying to help you! Guess you don’t want it, huh?
Here, this is a little something for you. You ask me a couple of questions, and then let me go, sound good?
Consider this a token of appreciation from us fine upstanding citizens. Come on, take it.
Ignoring my offer, are you? You’re one tough nut to crack!
How much longer you gonna dig through my stuff?
Check all you want! You wanna catch me? I’d like to see you try!
Now it’s my turn to search you!
You cops are like moles, always digging.
Haven’t you got anything better to do than stir up trouble?
You’re not the sharpest tool in the shed, are you?
You done with your little investigation yet?
Seriously? You really wanna start something with me?
I won’t let this slide!
Do you realize who you’re dealing with? This is my big bro!
You think you can push me around? My brother’s on his way right now!
You’re gonna wish you hadn’t messed with me!
You know who this is? Man, you really haven’t got a clue.
This guy calls the shots in Nova City! One wrong move could get you fired lickety-split!
You wanna give me a hard time? Your day just got a whole lot worse!
This guy look familiar to you? He’s a heavyweight!
Use your head, and stay out of my way.
You really wanna mess with me, huh? If you do, you won’t like the outcome.
Alright, Officer, hey…
My stomach… I can’t take it anymore…
Got it, urgh, this feels terrible…
Must be something I ate…
Argh, my stomach is killing me…
My stomach… can’t hold it in…
Hey Officer, all this patrolling must make you thirsty. Want some water?
Hmm… no?
What’s your deal?
You think you can boss me around?
You’ve got some nerve standing in my way!
You don’t know who you’re dealing with!
Ha, you think being an officer makes you a big shot?
You think you’re so high and mighty, trying to order me around?
Is this ever gonna end?
Are you done yet? You’re wasting my time!
It’s all your fault!
What do you want from me?
Are you trying to make my life harder on purpose?
You’re just bullying honest, hardworking people!
This is a total disaster!
I’m gonna miss out! You’ve ruined everything! Ugh!
This is all your fault!
You fixin’ to give me a ticket?
Listen up! I got connections!
You give me that ticket, and you can kiss your paycheck goodbye.
You have no idea what you’re doing, do you?
You think you can punish me?
My boss is gonna make sure you regret this!
I bet you get off on handing out tickets, huh?
Look at what happened to those guys!
You better watch out, or you’ll end up like them!
What, you need to gorge yourself on more of public taxes?
You need some quick cash, so you’re holding me up, is that it?
Ain’t you had enough of that government slop?
So now you’re coming to me hat in hand, are you?
How do you sleep at night, picking on upstanding citizens?
You better believe I’m gonna report you!
Officer, I don’t have a Golvent to my name, honestly.
Just let me go…
This means the world to me!
Aw man, I can’t have a criminal record…
C’mon, there’s gotta be some way we can work this out!
If I get slapped with a fine, my life is over.
This ticket seems kinda fishy… like it’s counterfeit or something…
I’ll pay the fine, it’s just… never mind.
Yeah, it’s my fault, but thanks to you…
Officer, how about I slip you this? Just don’t bust me, alright?
You call this a fine? It’s barely even worth writing out the citation!
Aren’t you willing to cut a deal?
Officer, this is everything I have on me…please let me go.
Then you might as well spend some time at the NCCA.
I’ll take you on!
Come on, Officer, let’s make a deal… why don’t you let me walk?
Makes sense, but I’ll pass.
What!? You’ve got some nerve disrespecting my offer!
Someone’s getting hit!
Things are getting dangerous over there!
Go save them, hurry!
我们的磁场相斥，斥力不允许我再待在这里！
records.__RAW__Message: 我们的磁场相斥，斥力不允许我再待在这里！

records.Message: 不！别想再给我喂奇怪的饲料，也别想用电极折磨我的脑子！
records.__RAW__Message: 不！别想再给我喂奇怪的饲料，也别想用电极折磨我的脑子！

records.Message: 蹄子状态很好！捕食者，别想追上我！
records.__RAW__Message: 蹄子状态很好！捕食者，别想追上我！
